resources.string: Private Communication. No Central Server. No Persistent Conversations.
No phone number, email, or central account registry required.
No company-operated central messaging server or cloud database.
Both participants must be online simultaneously over Tor Onion Services.
Conversations exist strictly in volatile RAM and vanish on disconnect.
Tor Onion routing introduces latency and depends on circuit availability.
No software can guarantee protection against a compromised OS kernel or live hardware forensics.
I understand and accept these operational and security limitations.
Tap to return or terminate active volatile session.
